faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking.

supplies.q: Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?
supplies.a: Yes! Our cleaners arrive fully equipped with professional-grade, eco-friendly cleaning products and equipment. If you prefer we use your own products, just let us know in the WhatsApp message.

keys.a: We offer flexible options: you can be home to let us in, leave a key with a neighbour or concierge, or use a key lockbox. Many of our regular clients provide us with a key after building trust.

cancellation.a: We offer free cancellation up to 24 hours before your scheduled cleaning. Cancellations within 24 hours may incur a small fee. Rescheduling is always free — just message us on WhatsApp!

pets.a: Absolutely. We use non-toxic, biodegradable products that are safe for cats, dogs, and all household pets. Just mention any allergies when booking.

duration.q: How long does a cleaning take?
duration.a: A standard home cleaning (55–85 m²) typically takes 2–3 hours. Deep cleans take longer (3–5 hours). We'll confirm the estimated time in your WhatsApp quote.

frequency.a: Yes! Most of our clients book weekly or bi-weekly. Regular clients get priority scheduling and discounted rates. Just ask on WhatsApp and we'll set it up.

sections.p: ReadySetSiivous provides cleaning services in the Helsinki metropolitan area. You can reach us at info@readysetsiivous.fi.

We only process the information you choose to send us via WhatsApp or email — typically your name, phone number, city, preferred date, and any details in your messages. This website itself does not store personal data on servers.
Your language and theme preferences are saved only in your own browser (localStorage) and never leave your device. No advertising or analytics cookies are used.
Your details are used solely to prepare quotes, schedule cleanings, and provide services. We never sell or share your data with third parties, except where required by law.
Under the EU GDPR you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing info@readysetsiivous.fi.
ReadySetSiivous provides home, deep, move-out, office and related cleaning services in the Helsinki metropolitan area as described on this website.
Quotes sent via WhatsApp are estimates based on the information you provide. The final price may vary if the actual condition or size differs from what was described.
You may cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the scheduled cleaning. Later cancellations may incur a small fee. Rescheduling is always free.
Payment is made after the service via the methods listed on the site. We provide the documents needed for the Finnish household-expenses tax credit (kotitalousvähennys).
Our staff are trained, background-checked, and insured. Please inform us in advance of fragile or high-value items. Our liability is limited to the extent permitted by Finnish law.
These terms are governed by Finnish law. Disputes are resolved in the courts of Finland.
